fusions.name: Fling and Catch
fusions.desc: Flings your shield at an enemy up to 6 tiles away and catches it on the return, dealing 8 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Final Grip
fusions.desc: Grips a target at or below 25% health behind your shield and wrenches it, dealing 26 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pull Clear
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you and from every ally near you.

fusions.name: Steady Gauntlet
fusions.desc: Conjures a gauntlet for your shield hand: your maximum health rises by 12, your armour by 6% and your critical chance by 4%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 3 health.
